intro k
have h : Irrational (erdos_252_sum k) := by
  classical
  have h1 : ∃ n, n ≥ 1 := ⟨1, by norm_num⟩
  rcases h1 with ⟨n, hn⟩
  exact Irrational.of_not_rat (by
    intro ⟨q, hq⟩
    have h₂ : q = 0 := by
      have := hq
      have h₃ := eq_of_eq_natAbs
      (by
        exact h₃)
    contradiction)
exact h
